files.wiki-greenhouse.html:
Orbital Station 7

Home Crew Schedule Boarding Wiki

The Greenhouse

The greenhouse is the only green room on the station. It gives the crew fresh food, and a little fresh air too.

What grows here

Tomatoes, beans, basil and lettuce. Kenji Arano, the station's botanist, looks after them and picks something for dinner every day.

Light

There is no sun inside the station. Blue and red lamps shine on the plants for 16 hours a day, then switch off so the plants can rest.

Water

Nothing is wasted. The station cleans the water the crew has used, and the plants drink 60 liters of it every day.

Seeds

Every plant starts as a seed in a small cube of soft wool. Kenji Arano keeps the seeds in a cold box, each kind in its own bag with its name and the day it came on board.

Every plant starts as a seed in a small cube of soft wool. Kenji Arano keeps the seeds in a cold box, each kind in its own bag with its name and the day it came on board.

Roots

Without weight, roots don't know which way is down. So they grow toward the water, and the crew guides them with thin tubes that bring it to each plant.

Pests

No insects live on the station, so nothing eats the leaves. But a sick plant can make the others sick too, so it leaves the greenhouse at once.

Harvest

A tomato is ready when it is red all over. The crew eats it the same day, because fresh food is the best part of the week up here.

Visitors

Visitors may look at the plants through the window of the door. They may not touch them, and they never bring food from outside into the room.

Mistakes

In the first year, the lamps stayed on all day and night, and the plants grew tall and weak. Now they rest eight hours a day, as they would on Earth.

Facts

  • Plants: 4 kinds
  • Light: 16 hours a day
  • Water: 60 liters a day
  • Warmth: 24 °C

Orbital Station 7 · Docking Ring B · Low Earth Orbit

Written by the crew, for everyone on board and back on Earth.
